 Happy Hour: Forecast for SDSU-UNI, Augie & USF, prep state semifinals 
 It's a local Friday football preview show with John Gaskins and Trent Singer that packs plenty of information and entertainment. But don't take our predictions to the bank.
 By 
 John Gaskins 
 November 06, 2026 at 11:00 AM 
 Listen
 Comments
 Share
 Share this article 
 Should we sound the "Upset Alert" sirens for South Dakota State at Northern Iowa on Saturday?
 After all — stop us if you've heard this — the Panthers are 4-0 in the UNI-Dome with a couple of (at the time) Top 10 teams exiting Cedar Falls with tails between their legs.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Trap game? Letdown game? Maybe. Maybe not...
 Every Friday, the Happy Hour host and Sioux Falls Live sportswriter Trent Singer get together at the Orion Pub in downtown Sioux Falls to unfurl all the storylines, stats, and matchups of a game like this and predict what might happen.
 The Jackrabbits are 14.5-point favorites. Will they cover? Will they even win?
 Tune in to find out. Then, make fun of these clowns if (or when) they end up being way off!
 Show motto: Don't take us to the bank!
 Also on the docket:
 * No. 21 Augustana at No. 3 Minnesota State
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 * USF at Wayne State
 * 11AAA State Semifinals! Both games will be televised live on KSFL-TV (Ch. 36 / Midco Ch. 616) and the Midwest Sports Plus app! To get the app, 
 go here! 
 No. 4 Harrisburg at No. 1 Jefferson, 5 p.m.  
 No. 3 Brandon Valley at No. 2 Lincoln, 7:30 p.m.
